_comment: Orchestration section of the catalog site. Summarises claude/skills/project-manager/SKILL.md (sections 0-2) and claude/rules/agent-routing.md; update this file when either changes. build_site.py fails if an agent named here is not in claude/agents/.
intro: The project-manager skill is a router: it never writes code itself. It checks whether the work already exists, sorts the request into a tier by size and risk, then hands it to specialist agents in a fixed order. Agents with no shared input run in parallel, sent together in one message.

preflight.title: Already-done check
preflight.note: Searches git history and the codebase for the feature. If it already exists and is merged, the PM reports that and stops: no agents run. Skipped for bug fixes and refactors.

preflight.title: Classify the tier
preflight.note: Small, medium or large by the triggers below. Unsure between 1 and 2: unverified backend or 5+ interaction states means Tier 2.

tiers.name: Fast path
tiers.triggers: UI/UX tweaks, text changes, simple CSS fixes, label renames

stages.note: Finds the files and patterns to reuse. Returns them inline; no task file is created.
Makes the change, then self-checks: exactly what was asked, no stray files, no new data access.
Only if the change touches auth, permissions, data access, migrations, secrets or privileged server code.

tiers.name: Standard path
tiers.triggers: CRUD operations, form logic, category management, well-understood APIs

stages.note: Reusable code and conventions.
Ambiguities, edge cases, testable acceptance criteria. Pauses for the user on a blocking question.
Merges both outputs into one self-contained task file.
Implements exactly what the task file says.
Checks every acceptance criterion; updates the changelog on PASS.
Security, performance and architecture audit: APPROVED or BLOCKED.

Verifies UI changes in the running app through the DOM. Skipped for non-UI tasks or if the environment is offline. When it passes, the PM offers a post-orchestration manual check with a prioritized list.
Records new root causes and anti-patterns. On a fully clean run the PM writes "no new entries" instead of spawning it.

tiers.name: Extended path
tiers.triggers: Unknown or unverified backend APIs, complex interaction states, data aggregations, auth, exports

stages.note: Reusable code and conventions.
Ambiguities, edge cases, testable acceptance criteria. Pauses for the user on a blocking question.

stages.title: Discover APIs
stages.note: The PM reads the project's API inventory. Endpoints are never assumed to exist.
Maps every UI action to an endpoint and marks it EXISTS or MISSING, with a gap plan. If half or more are MISSING, the chain stops and asks the user.
Consolidates specs, decisions and the technical schema into one task file.
Frontend work plus any approved backend gap work.
Checks every acceptance criterion; updates the changelog on PASS.
Security, performance and architecture audit: APPROVED or BLOCKED.

Verifies UI changes in the running app through the DOM. Skipped for non-UI tasks or if the environment is offline. When it passes, the PM offers a post-orchestration manual check with a prioritized list.
Also records MISSING-endpoint fallbacks that shipped. Skipped on a fully clean run.

fix_loop.note: If reviewers or live-verifier find a problem, blocker lists go back to fullstack-developer in one pass, then re-verification runs. The same blocker surviving 2 fixes stops the chain and goes to the user. A PASS WITH AMENDMENT (contradicting acceptance criteria, code is fine) is fixed in the task file by the PM, not sent back to the developer.
